## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

2. Which sectors are leading?
Technology lead: MSFT (1W: +14.00% | 1M: +7.91%) ABOVE TREND, ORCL (1W: +26.77% | 1M: +14.89%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +13.61% | 1M: +39.57%) ABOVE TREND. Consumer Discretionary strong: TSLA (1W: +14.81% | 1M: +2.00%) ABOVE TREND, BKNG (1W: +10.69% | 1M: +9.56%) ABOVE TREND. Financials firm: PYPL (1W: +12.31% | 1M: +13.95%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: +0.14% | 1M: +8.39%) ABOVE TREND.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W movers: ORCL (1W: +26.77% | 1M: +14.89%) ABOVE TREND, SHOP (1W: +18.38% | 1M: +5.98%) ABOVE TREND, NOW (1W: +16.46% | 1M: -14.99%) RECOVERY, MSFT (1W: +14.00% | 1M: +7.91%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +13.61% | 1M: +39.57%) ABOVE TREND. Note minor divergence: NOW, PLTR, INTU showing RECOVERY (1W up / 1M down) — watch for follow-through.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Tech is leading but concentrated among a handful of names; AAPL (1W: +3.74% | 1M: +8.12%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +6.92% | 1M: +11.80%) ABOVE TREND, GOOGL (1W: +7.70% | 1M: +11.05%) ABOVE TREND, META (1W: +9.32% | 1M: +11.84%) ABOVE TREND. Sector 1W:+9.46% and driving the Growth/Momentum tilt; leadership narrow so monitor dispersion.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials showing breadth and strength; PYPL (1W: +12.31% | 1M: +13.95%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: +4.16% | 1M: +6.02%) ABOVE TREND, MA (1W: +4.54% | 1M: +6.90%) ABOVE TREND. WFC (1W: -4.67% | 1M: +6.85%) CORRECTION but recent bullish sentiment creates a watchable divergence.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare broadly neutral-to-positive; UNH (1W: +6.67% | 1M: +14.17%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: -1.79% | 1M: -1.31%) BELOW TREND, LLY (1W: -1.32% | 1M: +0.98%) CORRECTION. Sector 1W:+0.84% — defensive names mixed, monitor biotech/regulatory headlines.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor selective exposure to Technology and Financials leaders while reducing exposure to Energy and laggard Utilities; monitor narrow leadership risk in Tech. Style: Growth/Momentum tilt but selective stock selection advised given concentration and some divergences.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: ORCL (1W: +26.77% | 1M: +14.89%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +14.00% | 1M: +7.91%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +13.61% | 1M: +39.57%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: XOM (1W: -3.98% | 1M: -7.08%) BELOW TREND, EOG (1W: -4.97% | 1M: -5.88%) BELOW TREND, WFC (1W: -4.67% | 1M: +6.85%) CORRECTION — watch sentiment/price divergence.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Technology (1W:+9.46%) and Financials (1W:+3.35%) given leaders and positive earnings/sentiment. BEARISH: Energy (1W:-3.68%) and Utilities (1W:-1.32%) where price action remains weak.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
NVDA (1W: +6.92% | 1M: +11.80%) ABOVE TREND — watch hold above recent breakout highs for continuation. AAPL (1W: +3.74% | 1M: +8.12%) ABOVE TREND — watch reversal below near-term support for rotation signs. JPM (1W: +0.14% | 1M: +8.39%) ABOVE TREND — watch follow-through on relative strength vs banks. XOM (1W: -3.98% | 1M: -7.08%) BELOW TREND — failure to reclaim short-term resistance increases downside risk.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
WFC (+80): Wells Fargo consent order exit — price in CORRECTION (1W: -4.67% | 1M: +6.85%) — bullish news but short-term price weakness, monitor for follow-through. MSFT (+50): AI/autos cloud headlines — price confirming ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.00% | 1M: +7.91%) — sentiment confirmed. MA (+50): analyst optimism — price ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.54% | 1M: +6.90%) — confirming strength.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
AAPL (-50): antitrust headline — price ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.74% | 1M: +8.12%) — bearish news but price rising (divergence). XOM (-50): price-target cuts — price BELOW TREND (1W: -3.98% | 1M: -7.08%) — sentiment confirms weakness. EOG (-50): target trims — price BELOW TREND (1W: -4.97% | 1M: -5.88%) — bearish confirmed.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL regime with a Growth/Momentum tilt driven by concentrated Tech leadership. MSFT (1W: +14.00% | 1M: +7.91%) ABOVE TREND, ORCL (1W: +26.77% | 1M: +14.89%) ABOVE TREND and AMD (1W: +13.61% | 1M: +39.57%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: narrow Top-5 tech concentration and several sentiment/price divergences (WFC, AAPL, energy names) — monitor for rotation or trend break.
